findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_notice · Private data: get_notice, search_local_bids, sbir_awards · Public sink: vehicle_match, search_local_bids · Destructive: run_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_notice · Private data: get_notice, search_local_bids, sbir_awards · Public sink: vehicle_match, search_local_bids · Destructive: run_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
